c74object.name: lp.scamp~
c74object.description: lp.scamp~ scales and offsets signals and can limit them to a range by clipping, wrapping or reflecting. If minimum and maximum are equal, wrap and reflect leave values uncorrected (since 2026; before, NaN). In map mode with equal low and high input values, or with a curve so extreme that the result overflows, the output is 0 (since 2026; before, inf or NaN).

method.name: float
method.digest: Value to scale and offset (or map) (left inlet)
method.description: Value to scale and offset (or map) (left inlet).

method.name: reflect

method.description: Reflect out-of-range values back into the range.
